title: Merged, numbered and specific, or it does not count
takeaway: An open source entry is worth listing only when a reader who clicks the link finds merged work and a named failure.
sources: A merged pull request is one of the few claims on a resume that a hiring manager can verify in thirty seconds.
It is a link, it is verifiable, and including it signals you expect to be checked.
Not "fixed a bug" - the specific failure.

before.label: An unmerged, vague claim
lines: (an unmerged or still-open PR behind it)

after.label: A merged, checkable entry
lines: Fixed a race condition in cache

change: The PR number makes it verifiable
The specific failure, not "fixed a bug"
